findings.label: Create-time scoping is unreachable
findings.detail: The Cloud Account Access picker only renders after the edited user's clientId resolves from the existing users list, which never happens for a brand-new user, so create always sends an empty accountAccessIds list (= all access). This is the intended default under the empty-list convention, not a defect. Flag only if product expects account scoping at creation time.

findings.label: Unrelated postman edit bundled
findings.detail: postman/xamops-local.postman_environment.json changes CUR_RESOURCE_ID and CUR_PERIOD sample values, unrelated to the cloud-account-access feature. Consider dropping it from the commit to keep the change focused.
